decisions.reason: The product builds directly on the firm's existing laser and enclosure engineering knowledge, giving high absorptive capacity to interpret market feedback and improve it, so keep.
Thermal inkjet technology is largely outside the firm's mechanical core, limiting its ability to assimilate results and improve, making it likely to be dropped.
Piezo inkjet leverages the firm's precision mechanics and control expertise, providing enough absorptive capacity to learn from early results and keep it, though with moderate risk.
